source_fragments.fragment: The drawing and the bill disagree.
The checks use smeared areas at full radius and do not resolve station lengths, sections or connections.
Rendering segments are not physical member counts.
No aircraft has been built or flown.
let [aI1, aTh1, aOe1, aSp1, ov] = solve

source_identity_mappings.source_role: Barrel accounting area row with no independently drawn counterpart.
source_identity_mappings.limit: Source bill domain and declared unit identity only. Drawn quantity and counterpart remain unknown; no area, mass, count or dimension copied.

source_identity_mappings.source_role: Source baseline outer extra-area state, not a physical flange section.

source_locators.fragment: let [aI1, aTh1, aOe1, aSp1, ov] = solve

source_identity_mappings.limit: State depends on model configuration/basis and source solve path. No state evaluated or adopted. This is the first-solve baseline, not a later reserve difference.

source_identity_mappings.source_role: Baseline aOe1 is used in a density/barrel-domain derived-mass expression.
source_identity_mappings.limit: Source uses model density, outer radius and cylindrical length with a mass-unit conversion. No factors, values or formula evaluation copied; this is conditional source accounting, not weighed reinforcement.

source_identity_mappings.source_role: Returned skeleton accounting field names the baseline flangeT.
source_identity_mappings.limit: Return identity does not establish an independent drawing, installed member, location, section, material or connection.

source_identity_mappings.source_role: The source includes the returned baseline flange mass in member aggregation with its joint adder convention.
source_identity_mappings.limit: Inclusion in source member accounting is separate from actual installed coverage. No reserve, allowance or other member maps are reproduced.

source_identity_mappings.source_role: The ordinary ledger key derives from skel.flangeDoublerT with the source joint adder.
source_identity_mappings.limit: The ledger entry is conditional source mass accounting, not a complete physical manifest or evidence of actual reinforcement installation.

requirements.existing_boundary: Match flangeDoubler census barrel-area domain with baseline return and ordinary ledger conventions without treating them as installed geometry.
prospective_record_requirements: Original term/configuration/revision/domain/unit/inclusion and exclusion records, plus conditional accounting lineage.
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: An area-row label or derived ledger mass cannot establish a drawn or installed member.

requirements.existing_boundary: Census explicitly labels this reinforcement not independently drawn.
prospective_record_requirements: Actual reinforcement identity, drawing-to-member correspondence, source revision and unmodified installed configuration records when supplied.
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: Undrawn counterpart, omitted geometry or source zero does not establish physical absence or selected removal.

requirements.existing_boundary: No actual reinforcement station/span/connection coverage is supplied by a barrel bill domain.
prospective_record_requirements: Actual station/span/connection coverage and inclusion/exclusion correspondence tied to configuration and source custody.
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: A global barrel domain is not a station manifest, coverage map, member count or completed installation record.

requirements.existing_boundary: No actual installed or acquisition record accompanies the accounting field.
prospective_record_requirements: Unmodified original raw records, responsible custody, acquisition context and applicable calibration/uncertainty records.
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: Passing software checks and algebraic identity do not measure member presence, area or mass.

requirements.existing_boundary: Conditional accounting and schematic absence do not establish physical applicability.
prospective_record_requirements: Matched configuration/domain/reference and applicability evidence connecting accounting to actual reinforcement records.
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: No physical feasibility, section/load path/material validation, selection or qualification follows from a source name.

requirements.existing_boundary: Custody roles and any future adoption are unassigned/unknown.
prospective_record_requirements: Responsible record owner and adoption source/version/domain/criterion only when actually supplied.
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: Proposed roles are not appointments; paper completion does not choose a criterion, procedure or design.
